zh.summary: 修复完整包更新后的 Windows 启动竞争，统一启动过渡，并恢复插件诊断在深浅主题下的清晰显示。
highlights: Windows 完整包更新会等待旧桌面的 WebView2 会话释放；若系统仍在回收浏览器资源，新版本会在不删除用户数据的前提下有限重试，避免更新后首次打开出现资源占用错误。
插件诊断的覆盖关系标签改用与 DSH 一致的中性描边和主题文字颜色，在深色与浅色外观下均保持清晰可读。
启动窗口会在 DSH 加载层就绪后一次显示；同一加载层持续覆盖到工作台可交互，让启动到工作台保持连续。

en.summary: Fixes a Windows startup race after complete-package updates, unifies the startup transition, and restores readable plugin diagnostics in both themes.
highlights: Windows complete-package updates now wait for the previous desktop WebView2 session to release. If Windows is still reclaiming browser resources, the new version retries within a bounded window without deleting user data.
Plugin diagnostic override labels now use DSH-aligned neutral borders and theme text colors, preserving readability in both light and dark appearances.
The window now appears when the DSH loader is ready, and that same loader remains until the workspace is interactive for one continuous transition.
